meaning.en: Doing something late is better than not doing it at all.
meaning.it: Fare qualcosa in ritardo è meglio che non farla affatto.
meaning.uk: Зробити щось із запізненням краще, ніж не зробити зовсім.
meaning.de: Etwas spät zu tun ist besser, als es gar nicht zu tun.
meaning.fr: Faire quelque chose en retard vaut mieux que ne pas le faire du tout.
meaning.pt: Fazer algo com atraso é melhor do que não fazer.
meaning.zh: 晚做总比不做好。

meaning.en: Small, steady steps take you a long way, like learning a language.
meaning.it: Piccoli passi costanti portano lontano, come quando si impara una lingua.
meaning.uk: Маленькі, але постійні кроки ведуть далеко, як у вивченні мови.
meaning.de: Kleine, regelmäßige Schritte bringen dich weit, wie beim Sprachenlernen.
meaning.fr: De petits pas réguliers mènent loin, comme quand on apprend une langue.
meaning.pt: Passos pequenos e constantes levam longe, como aprender um idioma.
meaning.zh: 坚持小步前进就能走得很远，就像学语言一样。

meaning.en: You get good at something by doing it again and again.
meaning.it: Si diventa bravi in qualcosa facendola e rifacendola.
meaning.uk: Майстерність приходить, коли робиш щось знову і знову.
meaning.de: Man wird gut in etwas, indem man es immer wieder tut.
meaning.fr: On devient bon en faisant une chose encore et encore.
meaning.pt: A gente fica bom em algo fazendo de novo e de novo.
meaning.zh: 反复去做，才能把事情做好。

meaning.en: If you really want something, you will find a way to do it.
meaning.it: Se vuoi davvero qualcosa, troverai il modo di farla.
meaning.uk: Якщо чогось справді хочеш, знайдеш спосіб це зробити.
meaning.de: Wenn du etwas wirklich willst, findest du einen Weg.
meaning.fr: Si tu veux vraiment quelque chose, tu trouveras un moyen d'y arriver.
meaning.pt: Se você quer muito algo, encontra um jeito de fazer.
meaning.zh: 真心想做的事，总能找到办法。

meaning.en: Time is valuable: don't waste it.
meaning.it: Il tempo è prezioso: non sprecarlo.
meaning.uk: Час цінний: не марнуй його.
meaning.de: Zeit ist wertvoll: Verschwende sie nicht.
meaning.fr: Le temps est précieux : ne le gaspille pas.
meaning.pt: O tempo é valioso: não desperdice.
meaning.zh: 时间很宝贵，不要浪费。

meaning.en: I help you today, and one day you will help me.
meaning.it: Oggi ti aiuto io, e un giorno mi aiuterai tu.
meaning.uk: Сьогодні я допомагаю тобі, а колись ти допоможеш мені.
meaning.de: Heute helfe ich dir, und eines Tages hilfst du mir.
meaning.fr: Aujourd'hui je t'aide, et un jour tu m'aideras.
meaning.pt: Hoje eu te ajudo, e um dia você me ajuda.
meaning.zh: 今天我帮你，将来你帮我。

meaning.en: When things go badly, stay positive.
meaning.it: Quando le cose vanno male, resta positivo.
meaning.uk: Коли все йде погано, залишайся позитивним.
meaning.de: Wenn es schlecht läuft, bleib positiv.
meaning.fr: Quand les choses vont mal, reste positif.
meaning.pt: Quando as coisas vão mal, mantenha o bom humor.
meaning.zh: 事情不顺的时候，也要保持乐观。

meaning.en: A lot of talk or fuss, but little real result.
meaning.it: Tante chiacchiere o tanto clamore, ma pochi risultati veri.
meaning.uk: Багато розмов чи галасу, але мало справжнього результату.
meaning.de: Viel Gerede oder Aufregung, aber wenig echtes Ergebnis.
meaning.fr: Beaucoup de paroles ou d'agitation, mais peu de vrais résultats.
meaning.pt: Muito falatório ou alarde, mas pouco resultado de verdade.
meaning.zh: 雷声大，雨点小：说得多，做成的少。

meaning.en: Children are often like their parents.
meaning.it: I figli spesso somigliano ai genitori.
meaning.uk: Діти часто схожі на своїх батьків.
meaning.de: Kinder sind oft wie ihre Eltern.
meaning.fr: Les enfants ressemblent souvent à leurs parents.
meaning.pt: Os filhos costumam ser parecidos com os pais.
meaning.zh: 孩子往往像他们的父母。

meaning.en: People who threaten a lot rarely do anything.
meaning.it: Chi minaccia tanto raramente passa ai fatti.
meaning.uk: Хто багато погрожує, той рідко щось робить.
meaning.de: Wer viel droht, tut selten etwas.
meaning.fr: Ceux qui menacent beaucoup passent rarement à l'acte.
meaning.pt: Quem ameaça muito raramente faz alguma coisa.
meaning.zh: 爱放狠话的人，很少真的动手。

meaning.en: Sometimes it's wiser to stay quiet.
meaning.it: A volte è più saggio stare zitti.
meaning.uk: Іноді мудріше промовчати.
meaning.de: Manchmal ist es klüger, zu schweigen.
meaning.fr: Parfois, il vaut mieux se taire.
meaning.pt: Às vezes é mais sábio ficar calado.
meaning.zh: 有时候，不说话更明智。

meaning.en: What you don't know can't hurt you.
meaning.it: Quello che non sai non ti fa soffrire.
meaning.uk: Чого не знаєш, те не болить.
meaning.de: Was man nicht weiß, tut einem nicht weh.
meaning.fr: Ce qu'on ne sait pas ne peut pas nous faire de peine.
meaning.pt: O que você não sabe não te machuca.
meaning.zh: 不知道的事，就不会让你难过。

startLiteral.en: Better a bird in the hand
startLiteral.de: Besser ein Vogel in der Hand
startLiteral.fr: Mieux vaut un oiseau dans la main
startLiteral.pt: Mais vale um pássaro na mão

meaning.en: Something sure is better than many things you might get.
meaning.it: Una cosa sicura è meglio di tante cose che forse avrai.
meaning.uk: Щось певне краще, ніж багато того, що, можливо, отримаєш.
meaning.de: Etwas Sicheres ist besser als vieles, das man vielleicht bekommt.
meaning.fr: Une chose sûre vaut mieux que beaucoup de choses qu'on aura peut-être.
meaning.pt: Algo garantido é melhor do que muitas coisas que talvez você consiga.
meaning.zh: 确定到手的东西，胜过许多可能得到的东西。

meaning.en: Don't judge people by their clothes or their looks.
meaning.it: Non giudicare le persone dai vestiti o dall'aspetto.
meaning.uk: Не суди людей за одягом чи зовнішністю.
meaning.de: Beurteile Menschen nicht nach ihrer Kleidung oder ihrem Aussehen.
meaning.fr: Ne juge pas les gens à leurs vêtements ou à leur apparence.
meaning.pt: Não julgue as pessoas pela roupa ou pela aparência.
meaning.zh: 不要以衣着和外表判断一个人。

meaning.en: If you try to do too many things at once, you won't do any of them well.
meaning.it: Se provi a fare troppe cose insieme, non ne farai bene nessuna.
meaning.uk: Якщо береш на себе забагато одразу, нічого не зробиш добре.
meaning.de: Wer zu viel auf einmal macht, macht nichts davon richtig.
meaning.fr: Si tu essaies de faire trop de choses à la fois, tu n'en feras aucune bien.
meaning.pt: Se você tenta fazer coisas demais ao mesmo tempo, não faz nenhuma bem.
meaning.zh: 同时做太多事，哪件都做不好。

meaning.en: Starting early and working hard pays off.
meaning.it: Cominciare presto e impegnarsi dà i suoi frutti.
meaning.uk: Хто рано починає й старається, той досягає свого.
meaning.de: Früh anfangen und fleißig sein lohnt sich.
meaning.fr: Commencer tôt et travailler dur, ça paie.
meaning.pt: Começar cedo e se esforçar compensa.
meaning.zh: 早点开始、努力去做，就会有回报。

endLiteral.en: gets carried off by the current
endLiteral.it: se lo porta via la corrente

meaning.en: If you're not alert, you'll miss your chance.
meaning.it: Se non stai attento, perdi l'occasione.
meaning.uk: Якщо не будеш уважним, проґавиш свій шанс.
meaning.de: Wenn du nicht aufpasst, verpasst du deine Chance.
meaning.fr: Si tu ne restes pas attentif, tu rates ta chance.
meaning.pt: Se você não ficar atento, perde a oportunidade.
meaning.zh: 不保持警觉，就会错过机会。

startLiteral.en: From what's said to what's done

endLiteral.fr: il y a un long chemin

meaning.en: Saying you'll do something is much easier than doing it.
meaning.it: Dire che farai qualcosa è molto più facile che farla.
meaning.uk: Пообіцяти щось набагато легше, ніж зробити.
meaning.de: Etwas zu versprechen ist viel leichter, als es zu tun.
meaning.fr: Dire qu'on va faire quelque chose est bien plus facile que de le faire.
meaning.pt: Dizer que vai fazer algo é muito mais fácil do que fazer.
meaning.zh: 说要做某事，比真正去做容易得多。

meaning.en: Don't celebrate too soon: the final result is what counts.
meaning.it: Non festeggiare troppo presto: conta il risultato finale.
meaning.uk: Не радій зарано: важливий кінцевий результат.
meaning.de: Freu dich nicht zu früh: Das Endergebnis zählt.
meaning.fr: Ne te réjouis pas trop tôt : c'est le résultat final qui compte.
meaning.pt: Não comemore cedo demais: o que conta é o resultado final.
meaning.zh: 别高兴得太早，最后的结果才算数。

startLiteral.en: Not by getting up very early
startLiteral.fr: Ce n'est pas en se levant très tôt

endLiteral.fr: que le jour se lève plus tôt

meaning.en: Some things take their time; rushing doesn't help.
meaning.it: Certe cose richiedono il loro tempo: avere fretta non serve.
meaning.uk: Деякі речі потребують часу: поспіх не допоможе.
meaning.de: Manche Dinge brauchen ihre Zeit: Eile hilft nicht.
meaning.fr: Certaines choses prennent du temps : se précipiter ne sert à rien.
meaning.pt: Algumas coisas levam tempo: ter pressa não adianta.
meaning.zh: 有些事需要时间，急也没用。

startLiteral.en: Speaking of the king of Rome,
startLiteral.de: Wenn man vom König von Rom spricht,
startLiteral.fr: En parlant du roi de Rome,

endLiteral.en: he shows up at the door

meaning.en: Said when the person you're talking about turns up.
meaning.it: Si dice quando arriva proprio la persona di cui si sta parlando.
meaning.uk: Так кажуть, коли з'являється людина, про яку щойно говорили.
meaning.de: Man sagt es, wenn die Person kommt, über die man gerade spricht.
meaning.fr: On le dit quand la personne dont on parle arrive.
meaning.pt: Diz-se quando aparece a pessoa de quem se está falando.
meaning.zh: 正在谈论某人时，他正好出现了。

meaning.en: A good thing is welcome, even if it arrives late.
meaning.it: Una cosa bella è sempre benvenuta, anche se arriva tardi.
meaning.uk: Добру річ завжди раді бачити, навіть якщо вона приходить пізно.
meaning.de: Etwas Gutes ist willkommen, auch wenn es spät kommt.
meaning.fr: Une bonne chose est la bienvenue, même si elle arrive tard.
meaning.pt: Uma coisa boa é bem-vinda, mesmo que chegue tarde.
meaning.zh: 好事来得晚也值得欢迎。

meaning.en: A smart person understands without long explanations.
meaning.it: Una persona sveglia capisce senza lunghe spiegazioni.
meaning.uk: Розумна людина зрозуміє без довгих пояснень.
meaning.de: Ein kluger Mensch versteht ohne lange Erklärungen.
meaning.fr: Une personne fine comprend sans longues explications.
meaning.pt: Uma pessoa esperta entende sem longas explicações.
meaning.zh: 聪明人不需要长篇解释就能明白。

meaning.en: Stick to what you know; don't give opinions on things you don't understand.
meaning.it: Occupati di ciò che sai; non dare opinioni su cose che non conosci.
meaning.uk: Займайся тим, що знаєш, і не суди про те, чого не розумієш.
meaning.de: Bleib bei dem, was du kannst, und urteile nicht über Dinge, die du nicht verstehst.
meaning.fr: Occupe-toi de ce que tu connais ; ne donne pas ton avis sur ce que tu ne comprends pas.
meaning.pt: Cuide do que você sabe; não opine sobre o que não entende.
meaning.zh: 做你懂的事，别对不懂的事指手画脚。

startLiteral.en: Tell me who you go around with
startLiteral.uk: Скажи мені, з ким ти ходиш,
startLiteral.de: Sag mir, mit wem du gehst,

endLiteral.en: and I'll tell you who you are
endLiteral.de: und ich sage dir, wer du bist
endLiteral.fr: et je te dirai qui tu es
endLiteral.pt: e eu te direi quem és

meaning.en: The people you spend time with say a lot about you.
meaning.it: Le persone che frequenti dicono molto di te.
meaning.uk: Люди, з якими ти проводиш час, багато про тебе говорять.
meaning.de: Die Menschen, mit denen du Zeit verbringst, sagen viel über dich.
meaning.fr: Les gens que tu fréquentes en disent long sur toi.
meaning.pt: As pessoas com quem você anda dizem muito sobre você.
meaning.zh: 和你来往的人，很能说明你是什么样的人。

endLiteral.en: and they'll peck your eyes out
endLiteral.de: und sie hacken dir die Augen aus
endLiteral.pt: e eles te arrancarão os olhos

meaning.en: If you help someone bad, they may turn against you.
meaning.it: Se aiuti una persona cattiva, può rivoltarsi contro di te.
meaning.uk: Якщо допомагаєш поганій людині, вона може обернутися проти тебе.
meaning.de: Wenn du einem schlechten Menschen hilfst, kann er sich gegen dich wenden.
meaning.fr: Si tu aides une mauvaise personne, elle peut se retourner contre toi.
meaning.pt: Se você ajuda alguém ruim, ele pode se voltar contra você.
meaning.zh: 帮助坏人，他可能会反过来害你。

startLiteral.en: At a horse given as a gift

meaning.en: Don't criticise a gift; be grateful for it.
meaning.it: Non criticare un regalo: sii grato.
meaning.uk: Не критикуй подарунок, а будь вдячним за нього.
meaning.de: Kritisiere kein Geschenk, sei dankbar dafür.
meaning.fr: Ne critique pas un cadeau ; sois reconnaissant.
meaning.pt: Não critique um presente; agradeça.
meaning.zh: 别挑剔礼物，要心存感激。

sayings.start: Agua que no has de beber,

startLiteral.en: Water you're not going to drink,
startLiteral.de: Wasser, das du nicht trinken wirst,
startLiteral.fr: L'eau que tu ne boiras pas,
startLiteral.pt: Água que você não vai beber,

meaning.en: Don't get involved in things that aren't for you or that you don't want.
meaning.it: Non immischiarti in cose che non fanno per te o che non vuoi.
meaning.uk: Не втручайся в те, що тобі не потрібно або чого ти не хочеш.
meaning.de: Misch dich nicht in Dinge ein, die nicht für dich sind oder die du nicht willst.
meaning.fr: Ne te mêle pas de ce qui n'est pas pour toi ou que tu ne veux pas.
meaning.pt: Não se meta no que não é para você ou no que você não quer.
meaning.zh: 与你无关或你不想要的事，就别去掺和。

startLiteral.fr: Il n'y a pas de mal

endLiteral.en: that doesn't come for some good
endLiteral.it: che non venga per un bene
endLiteral.uk: яке не прийшло б на добре
endLiteral.de: das nicht für etwas Gutes kommt
endLiteral.fr: qui ne vienne pour un bien
endLiteral.pt: que não venha para o bem

meaning.en: Something good can come out of a bad situation.
meaning.it: Da una brutta situazione può nascere qualcosa di buono.
meaning.uk: З поганої ситуації може вийти щось добре.
meaning.de: Aus einer schlechten Lage kann etwas Gutes entstehen.
meaning.fr: Quelque chose de bon peut sortir d'une mauvaise situation.
meaning.pt: Algo bom pode sair de uma situação ruim.
meaning.zh: 坏事也可能带来好的结果。

endLiteral.fr: ce que tu peux faire aujourd'hui
endLiteral.pt: o que você pode fazer hoje

meaning.en: Do things now instead of putting them off.
meaning.it: Fai le cose subito invece di rimandarle.
meaning.uk: Роби справи зараз, а не відкладай їх.
meaning.de: Erledige Dinge jetzt, statt sie aufzuschieben.
meaning.fr: Fais les choses maintenant au lieu de les repousser.
meaning.pt: Faça as coisas agora em vez de adiar.
meaning.zh: 事情要马上做，别拖延。
